programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!

programme.title: The Nanny: Lamb Chop's On The Menu
programme.desc: Fran's preoccupation with his celebrity guests jeopardizes Maxwell's movie deal with Shari Lewis and Lamb Chop.

programme.title: The Nanny: Close Shave

programme.title: The Nanny: What The Butler Sung

programme.title: The Nanny: A Kiss Is Just A Kiss
programme.desc: Fran and Maggie enter a kissing contest with country music superstar Billy Ray Cyrus.

programme.title: The Nanny: Strange Bed Fellows
programme.desc: A fellow nanny's retirement causes Fran to worry about her own future.

programme.title: The Nanny: Chatterbox
programme.desc: Fran helps an aspiring actress find a job at her favorite beauty salon.

programme.title: The Nanny: Fran Gets Mugged
programme.desc: Fran loses a rare Shakespearean manuscript when she's mugged in the park.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Pen Pal
programme.desc: Fran worries about seeing a lifelong pen pal for the first time.

programme.title: The Nanny: Franny And The Professor
programme.desc: C.C.'s college professor brother bets he can make Fran a "Jeopardy" contestant.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Dope Diamond
programme.desc: Much to Maxwell's dismay, a handsome doctor proposes to Fran.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Poker Game
programme.desc: Al invites Steve to play poker with his friends, but ends up losing his paycheck to Al. Avoiding telling the truth to Marcy fails as Al plans to use his winnings to buy a fishing rod. Ultimately, Marcy enlists the help of Peggy to stop him.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Where's the Boss
programme.desc: When the owner of the shoe store is in a near-fatal plane crash, Al decides that it is time to get some recognition from his boss or quit his job. After quitting, Al returns to the shoe store, but not without a surprise.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Nightmare on Al's Street
programme.desc: Marcy freaks out when she begins having erotic dreams about Al after a heated argument about men vs women, and wonders whether she is actually sexually attracted to Al. Haunted by her dreams, Marcy ultimately comes to a conclusion and confronts Al.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Johnny B. Gone
programme.desc: Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint, Johnny Be Good's, when Bud and Kelly need them to solve their own problems. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for their bosses at home.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck Can Do It
programme.desc: Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 1
programme.desc: The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poppy's By The Tree - Pt 2
programme.desc: After a hair-raising encounter with the maniac, Al decides to get the family out of town. But, they are trapped at the motel by a storm and the locals are unwilling to help them.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If I Were a Rich Man
programme.desc: Steve takes Al to the vault at the bank where Steve works for a secret after-hours card game. The next day, one million dollars is reported missing.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Al gets heated up over the large phone bill and refuses to pay it. This results in the disconnection of the Bundy phone line and making him the target of hostility from Peggy, the kids and the Rhodes who now take the Bundys phone calls on their phone.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
programme.desc: While Al and Steve are occupied by a female employee who fixes the Bundy's refrigerator, Peggy invites Marcy to a strip club with the girls.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
programme.desc: Marcy loses her composure and wedding ring when it slips into a dancer's briefs while slipping him a tip. Desperate to keep the news from Steve, Marcy sets out to distract him every chance she gets.

programme.title: Cheers: King of the Hill
programme.desc: Sam går med på att spela en välgörenhetsmatch i softball mot ett lag av Playboy-pinuppor.

programme.title: Cheers: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: Sam återvänder till skolan för att få sitt gymnasiediplom.

programme.title: Cheers: The Mail Goes to Jail
programme.desc: Norm äventyrar Cliffs jobb när han tar över hans postutdelningsrutt för en dag.

programme.title: Cheers: Bar Bet
programme.desc: Ett gammalt vad tvingar Sam att välja mellan att gifta sig pch att förlora Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers: Behind Every Great Man
programme.desc: En vass reporter besöker Cheers och tröttnar på Sams arrogans.

programme.title: Cheers: If Ever I Would Leave You
programme.desc: Nick återvänder för att vinna tillbaka Carlas kärlek efter att hans fru har lämnat honom.

programme.title: Cheers: The Executive's Executioner
programme.desc: Norm tvingas ta en befordran som innebär att han måste avskeda sina medarbetare.

programme.title: Cheers: Cheerio Cheers
programme.desc: Diane väljer efter mycket tvekan att lämna Cheers och resa till Europa med Frasier, som har erbjudits en tillfällig tjänst vid Bolognas universitet.

programme.title: Cheers: The Bartender's Tale
programme.desc: Carla anställer en engelsk kvinna för att fylla Dianes plats medan hon är i Europa.

programme.title: Cheers: The Belles of St. Clete's
programme.desc: Carla hämnas på sin gamla rektor som hon verkligen hatade.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Murder Site / Sexual Harassment

programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Butt-Head blir snäll / Hemhjälpen

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case

programme.desc: Exploring a crashed ship on a desolate planet, Trip finds the stranded crew still alive despite the seemingly insurmountable odds, but something about them isn't quite right.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Blaze Of Glory
programme.desc: Sisko attempts to force his traitorous former officer to stop a final Maquis attack that could lead to the destruction of the Federation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: In The Cards
programme.desc: Jake and Nog risk an intergalactic incident in an innocent quest to lift Sisko's spirits.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: A Time To Stand
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew embark on a secret mission in a captured Jem'Hadar warship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sons And Daughters
programme.desc: Worf must face his failuresm as a father when his estranged son volunteers for duty aboard a Klingon ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Favor The Bold
programme.desc: While Kira prepares for the destruction of the Federation minefield, Sisko plans to retake Deep Space Nine.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Defiant
programme.desc: Wil Riker's renegade duplicate steals the Defiant and attacks Cardassian territory, forcing Sisko to assist Gul Dukat in stopping him.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Life Support
programme.desc: Bashir must use questionable methods in order to keep Vedek Bareil alive long enough to help bring about a Bajoran peace treaty with Cardassia.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ties Of Blood And Water
programme.desc: The imminent death of Kira's Cardassian "father" rekindles painful memories of losing her real father

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rocks And Shoals
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew are stranded on a remote planet with a dying Vorta and a small group of Jem'Hadar.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: His Way
programme.desc: Odo receives lessons in romancing Kira from a holographic 1960's lounge singer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Killing Game, The, Part 1
programme.desc: An enemy attack leaves Janeway and the crew believing they are characters in a World War II holodeck simulation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Killing Game, The, Part 2
programme.desc: World War II happens all over again as a holodeck simulation spills out onto the decks of Voyager.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Vis A Vis
programme.desc: When the Voyager stops to help an alien repair his ship, the alien switches bodies with Paris.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Omega Directive
programme.desc: Voyager comes across a space phenomenon that must be destroyed at all costs.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Chakotay meets a woman he once loved, but he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Exploring a crashed ship on a desolate planet, Trip finds the stranded crew still alive despite the seemingly insurmountable odds, but something about them isn't quite right.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Wrongfully imprisoned for ignorantly trespassing, Archer and Mayweather are taken prisoner by the Tandarans and find themselves in a Suliban internment camp.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Favor The Bold
programme.desc: While Kira prepares for the destruction of the Federation minefield, Sisko plans to retake Deep Space Nine.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sacrifice Of Angels
programme.desc: When the minefield is soon to be demolished, Sisko leads a mission to take back Deep Space Nine.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: You Are Cordially Invited
programme.desc: Worf's plans for a traditional Klingon wedding are threatened when Martok's wife refuses to accept Dax into their family.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: In The Pale Moonlight
programme.desc: Sisko attempts to trick the Romulans into declaring war against the Dominion.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Tears Of The Prophets
programme.desc: Ignoring the warnings of the Prophets, Sisko leads an invasion into Dominion territory.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Image In The Sand
programme.desc: With the wormhole closed, Sisko struggles to find a way to re-establish contact with the Bajoran Prophets.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: His Way
programme.desc: Odo receives lessons in romancing Kira from a holographic 1960's lounge singer.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadows And Symbols
programme.desc: Sisko's quest to find a mythical Bajoran orb leads him to unlock the truth about his own existence.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Caretaker, del 1
programme.desc: När de söker en saknad officer, sveps kommendör Kathryn Janeway och besättningen på rymdkryssaren Voyager 70 000 ljusår hemifrån.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Resistance
programme.desc: Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Resolutions
programme.desc: After contracting a deadly virus, Janeway and Chakotay are forced into exile on a planet that shields them from the effects of the fatal disease.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Macrocosm
programme.desc: Janeway, Neelix and the Doctor must retake Voyager from an infestation of microorganisms.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.
